findings.detail: Exactly one D-root host mount; 9p metadata now requires exactly one aname=drvfs and path=D:\ value. Conflicting or duplicate metadata rejects.
Guest output resolves to an existing canonical directory ancestor on the same ext4 device/source as the unique Ubuntu root mount. Tmpfs, alternate device and ambiguous deepest mountpoints reject.
Bigint statfs available bytes enforce unchanged12GiB host/8GiB guest plus nonnegative growth. Measurement and identity failures do not fall back to C: or guest capacity.
Windows registry mapping to D:\WSL\Ubuntu/ext4.vhdx remains coordinator-verified, hash-bound evidence. No registry refresh or real capacity measurement was performed by reviewer.

Correct guard alone does not authorize dispatch. Successors must freeze code, binding and provenance and pass current D: reserve plus growth. Reported actual D: capacity is below12GiB; thresholds were not relaxed.
